title: ADR-0150: record the maintainer's ruling on #37304 addendum points 4 and 6 (code-registered knowledge sources)
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cb4BAjgQ43tqy1DvVJ

Filing gate: ② follow-up out of #37304 (maintainer ruling 7192063608, Step 0 7191722341), filed by the owning zone ai-37000 under topic #37000, per the maintainer's standing permission for areas to file their own follow-up cards. Split from #37304 because an implementation card's file surface never includes `docs/adr/**`.
Grading: area:ai · Task · p2 (suggested; same grade as #37304) · reach: the ADR-0150 record read by every later knowledge card · evidence: ruling recorded.

## 维护者速读

- 做什么：把你 12:26Z 对「代码里注册的知识源算谁的」「代码如何指名两个应用包里的同名知识源」两题的选择，各用一行写进 ADR-0150 的附录。
- 谁受益：后续知识卡和 AI 写代码时有据可查，不再重复问。
- 不做会怎样：裁决只在卡评论里，ADR 附录仍写着「未决」。
- 需要你做的：合并时批准（ADR 属 Tier H）。

## What

In `docs/adr/0150-*.md`, under "Past the ruling's words" in the #37304 addendum, add one dated line under point 4 and one under point 6, each quoting the ruling comment 7192063608 and the option picked (A on both):
- Point 6: a source registered in code belongs to no package; it takes the package-less slot, keeps its bare key, face and index; the duplicate check compares `(package, name)`.
- Point 4 (last part): code names a source by its `NS-NAME` face under the tool's one rule; no `IKnowledgeService` signature changes.

No ruled sentence is rewritten. Tier H; contract tier (fable) build and review.

## Acceptance
- Two added lines, each with the date and ruling id; `node scripts/check-adr-symbol-anchors.mjs` passes; every old line of the file survives in order.
